purpose: Define schema-driven input primitives for text, number, boolean, enum/select, date/time and structured values, keeping edit buffers separate from accepted canonical state.

topics.name: Form Input Element
topics.purpose: Define schema-driven input primitives for text, number, boolean, enum/select, date/time and structured values, keeping edit buffers separate from accepted canonical state.

semantics.schema_rule: Input type, constraints and validation derive from explicit schema/field semantics.
semantics.buffer_rule: User-edited value is a local candidate/edit buffer until explicit submit/apply.
semantics.validation_rule: Client-side validation is advisory UX; authoritative validation occurs at canonical operation boundary.
semantics.binding_rule: Input binds to exact field/parameter identity.
semantics.secret_rule: Secret/sensitive inputs declare appropriate display/logging/redaction profile.
semantics.authority_rule: Ability to edit a field in UI does not grant submit/write authority.

invariants.rule: Expose Elements are reusable human-interface primitives that project or invoke explicitly bound semantics; visual form, nesting, focus, color, position or enabled-looking state never creates ownership, authority or domain meaning.

hard_gates.condition: typing immediately mutates canonical state without declared live-update operation
input field selected by label only
secret value exposed in normal logs
